threat_event: Phishing email (fake OTA guest complaint) installs an information stealer on the laptop; saved browser passwords let the attacker take over the innkeeping software, OTA-2, and email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptop shared with family; passwords saved in the browser; no MFA on the innkeeping software, OTA-2, or email; one reused password; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 laptop; SYS-01; SYS-03; SYS-04 (BP-01, BP-03, BP-04)
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA for the innkeeping software, email, and OTA-2; password manager and delete saved browser passwords; stop family use of the laptop; disk encryption; phishing training; P08 runbook

threat_event: Card numbers and security codes stored on the paper reservation pad and in emailed authorization forms are stolen or misused
threat_source: Thief, house visitor, or attacker in the email account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 pad pages since 2023 in an unlocked desk drawer; about 85 emails with card numbers (31 with security codes) since 2022; security codes kept after authorization
existing_controls: Owner stopped writing new card numbers on the pad on 2026-07-21
treatment_plan: Shred all pad pages and purge card forms from email; stop accepting card forms by email; pay-by-link for phone bookings; never record security codes

threat_event: Payment facilitator raises fees, holds funds, or ends the merchant account because PCI DSS validation was never completed and card data is stored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Never validated; $19.95 monthly non-compliance fee since 2024; current design would require SAQ D
treatment_plan: Redesign to SAQ A plus SAQ P2PE (P03); submit both SAQs and attestations by 2026-12-31; keep the facilitator's 2026-08-14 email on file

threat_event: Attacker phishes the innkeeping or OTA-2 password (no malware) and sends upcoming guests fake payment-verification links from the inn's own messaging
threat_source: Cybercriminal (credential phishing of hotel partner accounts)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the innkeeping software or OTA-2; shared OTA-2 login; nobody reviews sign-in history
existing_controls: OTA-1 sends sign-in codes to the phone
treatment_plan: MFA on both accounts; named account for the relief innkeeper; monthly sign-in review; tell guests in the confirmation email that the inn never asks for card details by message

threat_event: Someone without a current reservation enters guest rooms or the house using an old master code, a shared login, or a forgotten lock app account
threat_source: Former cleaner or other insider; outsider with an old code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: House master code unchanged since 2022; relief innkeeper uses the owner's logins; lock installer's administrator account active until 2026-07-23 (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Per-reservation codes that expire at checkout; installer account disabled 2026-07-23
treatment_plan: Change the master code now, every quarter, and when a cleaner leaves; named accounts; quarterly lock app and innkeeping user review

threat_event: A guest on the shared Wi-Fi reaches the owner's laptop or signs in to the router with the default administrator password and redirects traffic
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guests and owner devices on one network; default router administrator password; firmware never updated
existing_controls: Router blocks unsolicited inbound traffic; laptop host firewall; SaaS traffic uses TLS; internet-side remote management turned off 2026-07-23 (found in P07 testing)
treatment_plan: Turn on the router's guest network; change the administrator password; update firmware

threat_event: Theft or loss of the unencrypted laptop exposes saved passwords, downloaded guest reports, and keyed card data in browser history
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No full-disk encryption; laptop used and carried by family members
treatment_plan: Turn on the built-in full-disk encryption and keep the recovery key in the sealed envelope; no family use

threat_event: About 1,900 guest ID photos are exposed through a lost phone or a takeover of the consumer photo backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Every guest's driver license or passport photographed since 2021; photos sync to a consumer account without MFA; no retention limit
treatment_plan: Stop photographing IDs (visual check, note the ID type in the register); delete existing photos from the phone and the backup; MFA on the account

threat_event: FTC or state complaint because prices are shown without the mandatory housekeeping fee and the privacy statement says card details are never stored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rate table, phone quotes, and chat show nightly rates without the $15 fee; booking engine adds it only at the final step; privacy statement inaccurate
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 website; SYS-11 chat; SYS-01 booking engine
treatment_plan: Fold the fee into the nightly rate or show the total price first everywhere; correct the privacy statement

threat_event: Owner is suddenly unavailable (illness, injury, evacuation) or loses the phone, and nobody can run reservations, door codes, or vendor contacts securely
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role; sign-in codes on one phone; continuity today depends on shared passwords
existing_controls: Relief innkeeper knows the routine (with shared logins)
treatment_plan: Named account for the relief innkeeper; sealed recovery codes with the owner's attorney; relocation arrangement with a nearby inn (P05)

threat_event: Innkeeping software outage lasts longer than one day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for calendar, codes, and messaging
existing_controls: Vendor RTO 4 hours and RPO 1 hour (SOC 2, P09); mechanical override keys
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Print the 14-day arrivals list each week

threat_event: Hurricane forces the inn to close for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single property on the coast; devices and paper on site
existing_controls: SaaS systems reachable from anywhere over the phone hotspot; owner evacuates with the laptop and phone
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Close availability in the OTAs and notify arriving guests when a storm watch is issued

threat_event: AI add-on raises rates sharply during a declared state of emergency, or the chat assistant quotes prices without the fee or keeps card numbers guests type
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rate suggestions apply automatically with no ceiling or emergency rule; chat quotes base rates; transcripts kept by the vendor
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: rate ceiling and daily change limit; emergency freeze; fee in every quoted price; card number masking and 90-day transcript retention

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or the facilitator's 24-hour notice or the Florida 30-day deadline is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, no contact list, no training; owner unaware of the facilitator's notice term
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contact list; walk it through with the IT consultant; owner training

threat_event: Contracts, tax documents, and receipts on the laptop are lost to device failure or malware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup of laptop files; innkeeping data never exported
treatment_plan: Move files to a business file plan with version history; monthly export of future reservations
